name: advance by a fixed linear combination of previous states and slopes
mechanism: keep a window of the last few states and their rates; the next state is a fixed linear combination of them (and, in implicit forms, of its own rate), so only one new rate evaluation is needed per step

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Linear multistep methods' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving:

requires: a start-up procedure to fill the window
fails_when: changing the step length invalidates the window; some coefficient sets are unstable
